12.constraint: Use this beige eyelet sleeveless knit once only for Spring/Summer Vacation, Resort, Festival, Travel, daytime Date or a restrained warm-weather Party. rejectionGroups.reason: These tight/bodybuilding tanks and tees use deep scoops, cutouts, shiny synthetic fabric or visible transparency and fail the modern versatile menswear bar.
The deep-V and asymmetric cutout tanks are revealing costume pieces rather than credible Zara-led warm-weather separates.
The asymmetric-collar shirt reads theatrical and costume-like rather than modern, versatile menswear.
The plaid hooded shirt is visually dated, busy and incompatible with the clean modern direction.
The knit tee remains generic and too closely fitted through the sleeves across the inspected colors.
These product-only openwork and pocket tops do not provide trustworthy adult fit or opacity proof and add generic repetition.
These active and quarter-zip tops are generic technical repeats with narrow or dark presentation and no sufficiently strong color-level fit proof.
These striped, plaid, novelty or gender-misaligned bottoms fail the clean contemporary men's styling direction.
These trousers and shorts have uncontrolled wide, balloon, cropped or puddled silhouettes, or only weak product-only fit proof; they recreate the baggy-bottom failure.
